202, then M:GrifballWebApp.Server.DatabaseBackup.BackupController.DownloadStatus(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken) follows it and M:GrifballWebApp.Server.DatabaseBackup.BackupController.Download(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken) hands it over: a large one takes
longer than a proxy waits for a response. 400 for another format; 409 while another backup or export is queued or
runs; 409 when there's no server here to make that native backup on (the message says why).

post.summary:

provider or a connection string it can't read. The connection string is used for this export only: never kept
or logged, and the job it's handed to gets it protected (readable for an hour).

Leaves for Discord's sign-in, which comes back to the login page (`/login?callback=true`), and that
page calls M:GrifballWebApp.Server.Identity.IdentityController.ExternalLoginCallback(System.Boolean,System.Threading.CancellationToken). followUp, the page to go on to, is kept

Discord sign-in and the bot know a player by the same Discord id: a first sign-in joins the account the bot already
links to that id, and an account made or signed in here gets that link (GrifballWebApp.Application.Identity.IDiscordAccountLinkService).
A POST, as it creates the user and signs in: the browser comes back from Discord to the login page (a page
of the app, not this action), which then calls this with the antiforgery token like any other change.
A new bearer token for a refresh token (bearer clients only; browsers have the cookie).

get.summary: Who is signed in: their display name, user ID and roles.

Who is signed in, for the client (in the browser, and on the server while it renders a page with the
visitor's cookie): M:GrifballWebApp.Server.Identity.IdentityController.MetaInfo, or 204 No Content for a visitor. Unlike MetaInfo, a visitor is
not an error, so the client asks on every first load without logging a failed request.

The antiforgery request token, which the browser sends in GrifballWebApp.Server.Identity.BrowserAuth.AntiforgeryHeader with
every change (GrifballWebApp.Server.Identity.CookieAntiforgeryFilter). Also sets the antiforgery cookie it pairs with. The
token belongs to the user signed in when it was made, so the client asks again after signing in or out.

post.summary: Signs the current browser session out.
post.description:
Clears the session cookie (and any half-finished Discord sign-in). No antiforgery token needed: signing
someone out is all a forged request could do, and SameSite=Lax already keeps the cookie off cross-site POSTs.
Also changes the user's security stamp, so a copy of the cookie (and the user's other sessions) stops working
within GrifballWebApp.Server.Identity.BrowserAuth.SecurityStampValidationInterval.

AccessTokenDto.description: A personal access token, as its owner sees it in their list: never its secret.

note.description: Why, e.g. "known as this in Winter League 2019".

BackupInfoDto.description: What the Database Backup page shows: the server the app is on, the migration a backup is at, and the formats it can download.

isGrandFinal.description: The grand final or its sudden death: these cannot be forfeited.

status.description:
A bracket match's or game's state, brackets-model's: sent as its number, as brackets-viewer compares it. The converter
here describes it so in the OpenAPI document (NumberEnumSchemaFilter); the one on each property is what sends it so.

opponent1.description: Only contains information about match status and results.

opponent2.description: Only contains information about match status and results.

number.description: The number of the match in its round.

child_count.description: The count of match games this match has. Can be `0` if it's a simple match, or a positive number for "Best Of" matches.

CaptainAddedResponseDto.description: The answer to AddCaptain: the name the server gave the new team.

placeholderUserID.description: Null when no placeholder has the gamertag: nothing to claim.

refusal.description: Why it can't be claimed; null when it can.

ClaimPreviewDto.description: A placeholder a gamertag claim would merge, and the seasons it played, before the claim is made.

ClientLogDto.description: A log line, in the trace it names (if any).

kind.description: `internal` (a navigation) or `client` (a call to the API).

ClientSpanDto.description: A finished span. Times are the browser's clock, in epoch milliseconds.

ClientTelemetryBatchDto.description: One batch from a browser: what it collected since its last. Every list and text is bounded.

ClientVitalDto.description: One Web Vital: web-vitals' value, milliseconds (CLS unitless).

nextTierAt.description: The count of the next tier; null once the last is reached.

tierFloor.description: The count of the tier reached; 0 before the first.

seasonsNotPublicBySignups.description: Seasons still to start that won't be public by their signups: to fix on their edit page.

CreateAccessTokenRequest.description: What to make a token for: a name to tell it by, and how many days it lasts.

accessToken.description: A personal access token, as its owner sees it in their list: never its secret.

CreatedAccessTokenDto.description: A token just made: the token itself is shown this once, and only its hash is kept.

DeploymentFinish.description: How far a team went in its season, best first.

season.description:
What a season is, the same on every page that shows one, imported from the historical archive or played in the app
alike. A DTO that is a season (GrifballWebApp.Application.Seasons.SeasonSummaryDto, GrifballWebApp.Application.Seasons.SeasonListItemDto) derives from it and is
projected by M:GrifballWebApp.Application.Seasons.SeasonInfoDto.Select``1(System.DateTime,System.Linq.Expressions.Expression{System.Func{GrifballWebApp.Domain.League.Season,``0}}); one about a season (a stat line, a title, a team) has it as its Season, loaded
by M:GrifballWebApp.Application.Seasons.SeasonInfoDto.LoadAsync(GrifballWebApp.Application.Database.IApplicationDbContext,System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{System.Int32},System.DateTime,System.Threading.CancellationToken). Either way the fields are projected here only.

wins.description: The team's record, as the standings and team page count it (TeamRecord).

recordFromSource.description: The record is the source spreadsheet's: the season's matches are not in the app.

finish.description: How far a team went in its season, best first.

championshipTiers.description: The tiers of the titles the team won (Pro, Open, ...), A to Z; empty unless GrifballWebApp.Application.Profile.DeploymentHistoryDto.Finish is Champion.

DeploymentHistoryDto.description: One team a player was on in a season (a deployment), newest season first on the profile.

DuplicateMatch.description: Why a pair was suggested, strongest first: the list is sorted by it.

targetUserID.description: The user it would be merged into: a signed-up user, or another placeholder.

match.description: Why a pair was suggested, strongest first: the list is sorted by it.

distance.description:
Edits between the two gamertags compared loosely (case, spaces, punctuation and a "#1234" suffix aside).
            Only GrifballWebApp.Application.Historical.DuplicateMatch.Edits is suggested for it; a framing or word match can be many edits apart.

DuplicateSuggestionDto.description: A placeholder that may be the same player as another user: merge it, or dismiss the pair.

DynastyDto.description:
A team name's titles across seasons (a team is one season's; the teams that carried a name from season to season
are counted together), with its latest title-winning team to link to.

ExportRequestDto.description: Where to export the database: SqlServer, Postgres or Sqlite, and the new database's connection string.

gamesDecidedByVote.description:
Of GrifballWebApp.Application.Profile.GameCareerSummaryDto.GamesPlayed, the Late League games decided by their players' vote: a win or a loss with no box
            score, so left out of every stat per game.

goals.description: Goals, added up across games on the all-games row too, as carrier stops are (medals are only totalled per game).

xboxUserID.description: Null for a user's or Discord claim whose user has no Xbox account linked.

userID.description: The user the placeholder is merged into on approval: the claimant, or the Xbox account's user.

claimantUserID.description: A user's or Discord claim: the user it is about.

firstSeen.description: A user's claim: when they say they had the gamertag.

currentGamertag.description: An XUID lookup: the account's gamertag now, and when it was looked up.

placeholderSeasons.description:
The seasons the placeholder played (its stats and titles), "Name (year)", oldest first: who used the
            gamertag then, to weigh against who holds it now.

HaloAuthCodeRequest.description: A Microsoft OAuth code for the site's Halo account (Direct mode).

HaloStatusDto.description:
What the Infinite Client page shows (`Admin/HaloStatus`). Direct mode: only GrifballWebApp.Server.HaloInfinite.HaloStatusDto.Mode; the page then
asks `Admin/CheckStatus` as it always has. Gateway mode: the gateway's address and admin page, whether this
environment has an API key for it (never the key), and a fresh probe: whether the gateway answered at all
(GrifballWebApp.Server.HaloInfinite.HaloStatusDto.Reachable), its Halo account's status word (GrifballWebApp.Server.HaloInfinite.HaloStatusDto.AccountStatus, from its `/health`) and
what the test call through it answered (GrifballWebApp.Server.HaloInfinite.HaloStatusDto.ApiCode).

reviews.description: Its seasons' removals that wait for (or got) a decision, and a preview's.

HistoricalImportJobSummaryDto.description: A job in the list: what it is and how it went, without its report.

seasonsRetired.description: Titles-only seasons the champions record made whose titles are another season's now, removed.

matchmakingSeasonsCreated.description: Matchmaking seasons (Late League) created and updated.

teamsRemoved.description: Rows of earlier imports this one didn't bring back, removed: teams (renamed or gone), stored totals, titles.

seasonMatchesCreated.description: Season matches made from Waypoint games, and the games linked to them.

recordedGamesImported.description:
Recorded (non-Waypoint) games added or updated; skipped as a Waypoint game's duplicate (by match ID, or the
            same two teams within GrifballWebApp.Application.Historical.HistoricalImportOptions.RecordedGameWaypointWindow, details in the warnings); and
            removed (no longer in the archive, or now a duplicate).

manualReplacedByWaypoint.description: Manual rows not imported, or removed, because the player has Waypoint stats for that phase of the season.

suggestionsCreated.description: Roster matches suggested for a sysadmin to decide (GamertagClaims).

discordLinked.description:
Players lists: Discord IDs linked to placeholders, placeholders merged into the user with that Discord ID,
            Discord matches left for a sysadmin (GamertagClaims), and regions filled in.

missingMatches.description:
Waypoint matches that are not in the database (could not be pulled, or not found), by season and phase:
            that phase kept its Manual stats.

skipped.description: Why something was left out, one line each.

warnings.description: What was imported but deserves a look, e.g. a sheet row of a Waypoint season no account matched.

errors.description: Seasons whose transaction failed and was rolled back.

seasonRemovals.description: Seasons this run removes (or would remove, a dry run) rows from, and those the guardrail stopped.

sourcesChanged.description:
A refresh of the sources: those whose content changed, those that failed (and why), how many were unchanged,
            and the import it queued.
